title: Cycle staffing conveyor and scope-slimming exchange
creator: Maya Thompson
description:
Problem: As cycles scale and multiple initiatives run in parallel, we lack a repeatable mechanism to move fractional staff between tranches and make deterministic scope cuts under uncertainty. Current playbooks are ad-hoc and cause delayed deliveries and uneven team load.

Proposal: Introduce a 'staffing conveyor' operational pattern plus a 'scope-slimming exchange' market for trading fractional scope. The conveyor maintains a rotating float (FTE buffer) allocated to tranches by signal (workback risk, blocker count, SLA exposure). The exchange is a lightweight negotiation protocol between PMs to swap or trim scope in units (3pt, 5pt, 8pt) with automated acceptance heuristics.

Goals: 1) Reduce mid-cycle emergency triage time by 30%; 2) Keep high-priority SLAs covered with <1 outage/week risk; 3) Make scope cuts predictable and auditable.

Mechanics: - Establish float pool = 1.0 FTE per 6 teams (configurable). - Signals: blocker density (>3/blocker per team), QTD burn rate (>1.2x), regression alerts from quality dashboard. - Conveyor actions: reassign 0.25-0.5 FTE for 2-cycle min; rotate every cycle boundary. - Exchange rules: scope items packaged into tradeable micro-units (3/5/8 pts), owners post offers to exchange board (Confluence + Slack bot). Acceptance auto-approves if exchange preserves OKR impact within +/-10% and does not increase customer risk tier.

Implementation plan: 1) Create exchange board template and Slack workflow (2 weeks). 2) Instrument signals in capacity dashboard and add conveyor allocation UI (3 weeks). 3) Pilot with Infra + Console + Serving teams for one cycle (Cycle 47). 4) Iterate and roll out org-wide with training docs.
acceptance_criteria: Conveyor float pool config surfaced in Console allocation page
Slack bot posts trade offers and records accepted exchanges in Confluence
Dashboard shows conveyor reallocations and impact on lead time
Pilot cycle maintained SLA targets and reduced emergency scope cuts by target percent
decisions: Use 0.25 FTE as smallest conveyor unit for reassignment
Tradeable scope sizes standardized to 3/5/8 story points
Auto-approval threshold set to +/-10% OKR impact as measured by scorecard
next_steps: Draft Confluence exchange board template (owner: Maya)
